sentences.text: This is first application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 filed by the applicant for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 1 of 2024 registered at Police Station Silwani, District - Raisen (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N), 376(3), 376(2)(Cha) of IPC and Section 16/17, 15(L), 5(N)/6, 16/17 of POCSO Act and Section 3/181, 146/196 of Motor Vehicle Act.
2 . Prosecution case in short is that on 01.01.2024, father of prosecutrix lodged a missing report.
Thereafter, prosecutrix was recovered and statement was recorded.

In her statement, she stated that present applicant/accused and co-accused namely Bhupendra took her in the Bhopal where co-accused Bhupendra committed intercourse with her on the pretext of marriage but present applicant/accused has not committed any offence with the prosecutrix.
2 MCRC-29283-2024 3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is further submitted that there is no allegation against the applicant in prosecutrix's statement recorded under Section 164 as well as 161 of Cr.P.C..
Only allegation against the present applicant is that he was present in the house where prosecutrix taken by co- accused/Bhupendra.
Accused is in custody since 05/06/2024.
Charge-sheet has been filed and conclusion of trial will take sufficient time.
On the aforesaid grounds, prayer is made to release the applicant on bail.

6. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
